plan.title: Closed RFQ report download with no fields selected

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ summary as required for prepared-state cases.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the report control is available.
Assert that the report-selection window opened.
Assert that the Excel download action is available in the window.
Submit the report request with the fields left in their current unselected state.
Capture any toast result produced by the no-selection submission.
Check whether submitting the report request produced a downloaded file.
